body:
Adds one selectable reconstructed horse to the 1835 Western Hotel yard, with a 12-second planted weight shift, provenance card, bounded drawn-yard support and host visibility/pause/resource ownership. Modern CC BY 4.0 model credit is separate from reconstructed historical appearance and placement.

Integrates DEV ea22b3c3055d0c6d40f213273138103fbc98cee3 while preserving both authored liberty additions, rebuilding five generated provenance outputs and retaining all 37 horse-only and 156 upstream-only source files. Source tree `5e7406c5d29f8a2be26e77cf098127dad5a6049d`; actual pushed head `79e215fc64a24dcbec7ea6eb1a3143b52f128852`.

Validation: original horse source eb1cafe12 passed all 1054 local checks (382 self-tests). The combined G11 local run disconnected and stopped after actual `spawnSync git EAGAIN`; it has no complete local PASS. The owner explicitly authorized one pre-commit exception for this reviewed integration. Actual committed-HEAD changelog, ID, whitespace, publisher, mirror and site checks passed. Fresh normal GitHub CI is required before DEV merge. Standard-loader/Mixer planted checks passed 65 keys and 64 midpoints; unchanged horse/runtime bytes retain that bounded proof.

This is a standing increment, not photographic completion. Fresh yard capture is pending. Anatomy, eyes/coat/hair, walking/trotting, tack, teams, drivers and riding remain open under T-2800/T-2803. Earlier nonpasses are preserved in chicago-evidence; no geometry, viewport or frame limits were relaxed.
